scripts.predev: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const d of ['.next-dev','.next']) { if(fs.existsSync(d)) fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true}); }"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n NEXT,API -c cyan,green "cross-env NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-dev next dev -p 3000" "cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000"
scripts.dev:reset: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-Process -Name node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach ($d in @('.next-dev','.next-build','.next')) { if (Test-Path $d) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $d } }; npm run dev"
scripts.prebuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const d of ['.next-build','.next']) { if(fs.existsSync(d)) fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true}); }"
